name: polarrecorder-dev-tooling
description: Polar Recorder developer-only quality tooling (no runtime dependency).

scripts.check:docs: node tools/check-docs.mjs && node tools/check-doc-format.mjs && node tools/check-doc-reachability.mjs && node tools/check-smell-catalog.mjs && node tools/check-agents-pointer.mjs
scripts.test:tools: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/js/agents-pointer.test.mjs tests/js/check-patterns.test.mjs tests/js/check-publisher-workflow.test.mjs tests/js/check-schema.test.mjs tests/js/command-graph.test.mjs tests/js/complexity-budget.test.mjs tests/js/coverage-inventory.test.mjs tests/js/eslint-config.test.mjs tests/js/format-scope.test.mjs tests/js/hooks.test.mjs tests/js/hotspot-budgets.test.mjs tests/js/install-script.test.mjs tests/js/js-checkers.test.mjs tests/js/release-create.test.mjs tests/js/release-git.test.mjs tests/js/release-prepare.test.mjs tests/js/release-version.test.mjs tests/js/setup.test.mjs tests/js/test-focus.test.mjs tests/js/test-inventory.test.mjs tests/js/typecheck-source.test.mjs
scripts.check:scaling: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; python -m pytest tests/test_operation_count_evaluator.py tests/test_polar_model.py tests/test_projection_scaling_contract.py tests/test_api_handlers_scaling_contract.py -q'
scripts.typecheck:python: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; python -m mypy server/polarrecorder tests plugin.py --strict'
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:source && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:python
scripts.test:viewer: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/js/viewer-theme.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-polar.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-smoke.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-enhanced.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-advanced.test.mjs
scripts.check:python-contracts: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; python tools/check-python-compat.py && python tools/check-py-contracts.py && python tools/check-py-dependencies.py && python tools/check-runtime-contracts.py'
scripts.package:check: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; python tools/check-release.py --dry-run' && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/js/release-create.test.mjs tests/js/release-git.test.mjs tests/js/release-prepare.test.mjs tests/js/release-version.test.mjs && bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; python -m pytest tests/test_release_manifest.py tests/test_check_release.py -q' && node tools/check-schema.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:ruff
scripts.duplication:check: npm run duplication:js && npm run duplication:python
scripts.check:standard: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run actions:lint && npm run duplication:check
scripts.test:contract: npm run check:headers && npm run check:namespace && npm run check:naming && npm run check:smells && npm run check:deps && npm run check:viewer-contracts && npm run check:hotspots
scripts.test:node: npm run test:tools && npm run test:contract && npm run test:viewer && npm run test:plugin
scripts.test:split: npm run test:python && npm run test:node
scripts.test:coverage:python: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; rm -rf coverage/python && mkdir -p coverage/python && python -m pytest tests/ --cov=polarrecorder --cov=plugin --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=json:coverage/python/coverage.json --cov-fail-under=90 --quiet'
scripts.test:coverage:viewer: rm -rf coverage/viewer && mkdir -p coverage/viewer/tmp && c8 --all --include 'viewer/*.js' --include 'plugin.js' --include 'plugin.mjs' --temp-directory coverage/viewer/tmp --report-dir coverage/viewer --reporter=json-summary --reporter=text --check-coverage --lines 80 --functions 80 --statements 80 --branches 65 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/js/viewer-theme.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-polar.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-smoke.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-enhanced.test.mjs tests/js/viewer-advanced.test.mjs tests/js/plugin-entrypoints.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage:check: npm run test:coverage:python && npm run test:coverage:viewer && npm run check:coverage-inventory
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:standard && npm run typecheck && npm run test:split && npm run check:python-contracts
scripts.check:core: npm run check:standard && npm run typecheck && npm run package:check && npm run test:focus:check && npm run check:smells && npm run check:python-contracts && npm run test:split && npm run check:complexity && npm run check:scaling && npm run check:docs && npm run check:filesize
scripts.check:all: npm run check:core && npm run test:coverage:check
